summary: The statement and proof are mathematically correct. The affine parametrization establishes a full-dimensional rational simplex, and the strict Boolean fiber witness establishes positive finite mixed volume. The projection minimization, original-coordinate fiber Jacobian and integration constants, and the distinction between the complete integer hub sums and the real hub integrals are all correct. The lattice-sum upper bound gives the claimed uniform factor 301. Direct checking of the three-variable periodization confirms its minimum is 1/2, and the restricted-volume estimate supplies the second factor 1/2 used for the non-Boolean lower bound. The polynomial degree comparison, the exponential estimate, the count of distinct leaf bases, and the explicit choice j = ell yield the stated factor 1204 times 150 to the power minus ell. Boundary fibers and all integer hub coordinates are retained. The conclusion is exactly the failure of an absolute Boolean-line mass constant, without any asserted upper bound on actual depth.
